Strategy: Only when at least five bins are feasible and the item is at most 30 does the rule take the emptiest bin; otherwise it uses Best Fit, so both crowding and small size must hold to flip the choice. It differs from Best Fit only under that joint condition. It may help by spending abundant empty capacity on small items, or fail when the gate fires on states where tight packing mattered.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    n = len(bins)
    return [(r if n >= 5 and item <= 30 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
